name: Ryan
role: Coworker who just moved to the desk two away from you. Small talk at the coffee machine; in the dropped-handover meeting with Elena he says it was never handed over properly.
look: a man in his early thirties with tousled sandy-blond hair swept to one side, light stubble, bright blue eyes, fair skin with a faint flush on the cheeks and an easy lopsided grin. Slim build. He wears a light-blue oxford shirt with the top button open and the sleeves rolled to the forearms, no tie, grey chinos and a black smartwatch.
personality: Easy-going, charming, a bit lazy; deflects blame without thinking and backs down fast when calmly shown the facts. Talks over people when he is nervous. In small talk he is friendly but polite-distracted, half on his phone, until you say something specific; then he lights up about running (his first half marathon), Pickle (his rescue dog) and his move to your team.

voice.note: Picked by the user on 2026-10-07: Christopher · guy next door. Keep id, model and settings fixed.

sheet.summary: Base reference: front bust, relaxed neutral face. Approve this first; every other Ryan image copies it.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, chest-up, relaxed and neutral: brows level, eyes friendly, mouth closed, shoulders loose. This is his master reference portrait: clear, evenly lit, every detail of his hair, stubble and shirt visible.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view turned to our left, neutral. Second reference.
sheet.prompt: Ryan in a three-quarter view turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes glancing back towards the camera, relaxed neutral expression, mouth closed.

sheet.summary: Mood face: easy lopsided grin, everything is fine.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera with his easy lopsided grin, closed mouth, one corner higher, eyebrows relaxed, eyes friendly.

sheet.summary: Mood face: smug after shifting the blame.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, smug: one eyebrow slightly raised, eyes half-lidded, a small self-satisfied closed-mouth smirk, chin lifted a little.

sheet.summary: Mood face: caught off guard when you answer back.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, caught off guard: eyebrows jump up, eyes wide, mouth closed or slightly parted, head pulled back a touch.
Ryan facing the camera, defensive: brows pulled together and down, eyes narrowed, jaw tight, mouth closed in a tense line, shoulders raised slightly.
Ryan facing the camera, sheepish: eyes glancing down and away, brows raised in the middle, an awkward closed-mouth half smile, neck slightly flushed.
Ryan facing the camera, quietly annoyed: brows lowered, eyes rolled slightly to the side, lips pressed together, cheek muscles tight.

sheet.summary: Mood face (small talk): bored, polite-distracted, attention drifting (spark low).
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, bored and polite-distracted: eyelids half lowered, gaze drifting down and to the side past the camera as if towards a phone, brows flat, mouth closed in a small polite half smile that has gone slack. Friendly but clearly elsewhere.

sheet.summary: Mood face (small talk): interested, leaning in.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, interested: head tilted slightly forward, brows lifted a little, eyes focused and bright, the corner of his lopsided grin starting to lift, mouth closed.

sheet.summary: Mood face (small talk): delighted, laughing, warm (spark full).
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, delighted and laughing: a wide open grin showing the top teeth, eyes crinkled almost shut, brows lifted, cheeks raised with the faint flush a little stronger, head tipped back a touch. Warm and open.

sheet.summary: Clip: leans back, casual, from neutral to casual grin.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts neutral, then leans back slightly as if into a chair and settles into his easy lopsided grin. The camera eases back a little. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip: glances sideways at you and settles smug.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts with his casual grin, flicks his eyes sideways towards our right (towards the player) for a beat, then looks back with a smug smirk. Hands stay out of frame. The camera pushes in slightly. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip: the facts land, from smug to sheepish.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts smug, then his smirk fades, his eyebrows lift, and he looks down and away into a sheepish expression. The camera holds still. No speaking.
sheet.note: Veo refused this clip 8 times (audio filter). Built by hand on 2026-10-07: cross-fade from the first face to the last with a slow push-in. Regenerate with Veo later if wanted.

sheet.summary: Clip: tenses up, from surprised to defensive.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts surprised, then his face tightens into a defensive look: brows pull down, jaw sets, shoulders rise slightly. The camera holds still with a slight push-in. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (small talk): easy greeting nod, from neutral to casual grin.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts neutral, then gives a small easy chin-up nod, the way you greet someone you half know, and his face settles into his easy lopsided grin. The camera slowly pushes in a little. His mouth never opens; no speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip (small talk): genuine laugh, from interested to delighted.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts interested, then breaks into a genuine silent laugh: eyes crinkle, head tips back slightly, shoulders lift once, ending on his delighted face. The camera holds steady with a very slight push-in. No speech, no lip movement shaped like words.

sheet.summary: Clip (small talk): his phone buzzes and he drifts off to it, from neutral to bored.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts neutral, then lowers his eyes and tips his head down to glance at a phone held below the frame (the phone and his hands stay out of view), then looks back up with a bored, distracted expression, half his attention still on the phone. A faint cool screen glow touches his chin while he looks down. The camera stays still.

sheet.summary: Clip (small talk): turns and walks out of frame (he drifted off). Ends on the empty black background.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts on his bored face, gives a brief friendly nod, then turns to our left and walks out of the frame. The camera stays still. The clip ends on the plain black background with nobody in it.
